{{Infobox Item |image= File:BotW Soldier's Broadsword Icon.png |caption= A Soldier's Sword |pronunciation= |plural= |type= |game= BotW, TotK |other= AoC |cost= |value= |location= |uses= {{List| * Attacking [[Enemy|Enemies]] * Defense }} |strength= |durability= |comp= [[Soldier's Set]] |sample= |theme= }} The {{Term/Store|Soldier's Gear|Soldier's Gear|BotW, AoC, Series}} is a recurring archetype of [[Weapon]] in {{TLoZ Series}}.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 169}}{{Name Ref|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Soldier's Gear was equipment issued to the soldiers who guarded [[Hyrule Castle (Dungeon)|Hyrule Castle]].{{Cite|{{Big|Soldier's Broadsword}}
A sword brandished by the soldiers who once protected Hyrule Castle. Its durable blade is well tuned for slaying monsters.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Soldier's Spear}}
A long spear once used by the guards of Hyrule Castle. Easy to use but difficult to master. The iron tip is very sturdy and the shaft will not burn when exposed to flame.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Soldier's Shield}}
A shield once used by the guards of Hyrule Castle. It's easy to handle, but its core is made of wood, so it can catch fire.|Inventory|BotW}} To this end, they are known to be of decent quality and [[Durability]].{{Cite|{{Big|Soldier's Claymore}}
A two-handed sword designed for combat. It's heavy and hard to use but has decent build durability and quality.|Inventory|BotW}} Soldier's Gear is primarily crafted out of iron, granting it an inability to burn when exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. They will also conduct [[Electricity]] and attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s, and they will sink if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]]. Finally, they can be picked up and manipulated with the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. Contradicting this, the [[Soldier's Bow]] and [[Soldier's Shield]] are constructed out of wood, meaning they are vulnerable to burning.{{Cite|{{Big|Soldier's Bow}}
A bow designed for armed conflict. Inflicts more damage than a civilian bow, but it will still burn if it touches fire.|Inventory|BotW}} They do not conduct Electricity or attract Lightning, they float when they are dropped in Water, and they cannot be picked up with the Magnesis Rune. ====List of Equipment==== {| class="wikitable" style="width:100%; max-width:57.5em; text-align:center" |- !style="width:25%"| Item !style="width:10%"| Strength !style="width:10%"| Durability !style="width:55%"| Description |- | [[File:BotW Soldier's Broadsword Icon.png|link=]]
